details: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen above $80,000, reaching a more than three-month high. This surge is largely attributed to a softer U.S. dollar and recent moves by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to calm the bond market, which has boosted momentum in the crypto sector. Additionally, U.S. President Donald Trump's recent call for Congress to pass the CLARITY Act to provide clearer definitions for the cryptocurrency industry has further fueled positive sentiment. Institutional "smart money" sentiment has also turned "extremely bullish" for Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80,000 Amid Bullish Macro Factors

details: Ethereum (ETH) has shown robust performance, with its price increasing by approximately 0.89% in the last 24 hours and an impressive 29.8% over the past week. This upward trend is supported by a resurgence in institutional demand, evidenced by significant Ethereum ETF inflows. BlackRock's ETHA ETF alone recorded $64.68 million in inflows on August 18, 2026, contributing to a total of $71.47 million for Ethereum ETFs on that day.
title: Ethereum Gains Momentum, Driven by Strong ETF Inflows

details: The overall cryptocurrency market capitalization has experienced a significant boost, increasing by 2.36% in the last 24 hours to reach $2.68 trillion. This broad market uptrend indicates a renewed risk-on sentiment among investors, leading to gains across various altcoins.
title: Global Crypto Market Cap Increases, Reflecting Broad Rally

details: MicroStrategy, a prominent institutional holder of Bitcoin, has announced the creation of a new "USD Cash" liquidity component within its digital asset strategy. As of August 23, 2026, the company holds 840,447 Bitcoin but has paused further Bitcoin acquisitions, instead opting to stockpile $6.69 billion in cash reserves. This move signals a temporary halt in accumulation from a key institutional buyer.
title: MicroStrategy Pauses Bitcoin Purchases, Shifts Focus to USD Reserves

details: Sui (SUI) experienced a 5.8% price decline following an announcement from Phantom Wallet that it will discontinue support for the Sui blockchain on September 24, 2026. This news has negatively impacted investor confidence and liquidity for the asset.
title: Sui Price Drops as Phantom Wallet Ends Support
